description: This file contains utility methods for working with Order and OrderType objects in the OpenMRS project, including type hierarchy checking and schedule overlap detection.

classes.name: OrderUtil
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling orders and their types within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks whether one OrderType matches or is a subtype of another OrderType, traversing parent types as needed.

methods.name: checkScheduleOverlap
methods.description: Determines if the schedules of two orders overlap based on their effective start and stop dates.
